baseline_models.focus_anchor: لم نك من المصلين: negated past being followed by من and a plural active-participle cohort.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal being makes the negation durative, while the prescribed-worship branch and the partitive construction classify the speakers outside a practicing group rather than recording one missed act.

activation_trace.role: Being or temporal predication supplies the continuing past state carried by لم نك.
Prescribed worship supplies the concrete practice that defines the excluded cohort.

changed_reading.after: We were not people whose continuing place among others was constituted by prescribed worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: المصلين, read through the focus root's supplication, praise, and mercy branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural practitioner noun can name repeated participation in a relation of asking, blessing, praising, and receiving or extending mercy, not only performance of a bounded rite.

activation_trace.role: Supplication, praise, and mercy supply a relational image for what the practitioners repeatedly enact.

changed_reading.after: They did not participate among those who repeatedly opened a relation of supplication, praise, blessing, and mercy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قالوا introduces an aloud first-person plural account of what they had been.
baseline_models.mechanism: The uttered-speech branch makes the answer public, while the held-doctrine branch lets the speech disclose an adopted orientation rather than merely report an external event.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the audible act by which the speakers expose their past.
Speech as a held doctrine makes the admission disclose the orientation they had lived by.

changed_reading.before: They gave a short factual answer.
changed_reading.after: They publicly articulated their former orientation: nonparticipation in the way of prayer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening commands form an embodied sequence of rising, magnifying, purifying, separating, and restraining oneself. Against that sequence, المصلين names practitioners of an ordered response, so the confession concerns refusal of a formative discipline as well as absence from a rite.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship anchors the changed reading in the focus practitioner noun.
Resolute rising supplies the initiating bodily and volitional movement of the discipline.
Magnifying something inwardly supplies the discipline's God-directed valuation.
Purifying self and action from ugliness supplies moral and practical cleansing.
Severance and departure supply active separation from the contaminating object.
Holding the self against panic supplies the discipline's sustained restraint.

structural_cues: 74:2-7 is a compact imperative chain rather than a list of nominal attributes.
The focus later uses a plural practitioner category, allowing that earlier sequence to function as a contrasting enacted way.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered imperatives and their branch images; I infer that their sequence sketches a formative practice against which prayer-membership can be read. A live alternative is that the imperatives describe prophetic commission broadly and do not specify what المصلين means.

changed_reading.before: They were outside the group that performed a prescribed rite.
changed_reading.after: They were outside the group trained by an ordered response of rising, revaluing, cleansing, separating, and enduring.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory holds worship and fire-contact under mapped ṣ-l-w/ṣ-l-y branches, while 74:26 explicitly activates being made to meet Saqar's fire. This creates an ironic reversal: voluntary entry into prescribed worship was refused, and compulsory entry into fire now frames the refusal.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship supplies the ordinary voluntary practice denied in the confession.
The focus root's non-dominant fire-contact branch supplies a latent punitive counter-image, not a replacement gloss.
Encountering or being made to enter fire explicitly activates the punitive side of the reversal.

structural_cues: 74:26 places the ṣ-l-y form inside the Saqar unit.
74:43 is the first answer to the question in 74:42 about what inserted the speakers into Saqar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared mapped inventory and the Saqar sequence; I infer a rhetorical voluntary-practice versus forced-fire reversal. The live alternative is that only the worship branch is semantically active in 74:43 and the fire echo is incidental wordplay.

changed_reading.before: We did not join those who performed prayer.
changed_reading.after: Our refusal of voluntary ṣalat is heard from within forced ṣaly: the declined practice returns as a fire-bearing counterform.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated لم نك and كنا clauses partition enduring affiliations: the speakers were absent from worship and feeding but present in collective discourse-wading and denial of accounting. The place-or-rank branch of being makes من المصلين a social location within that contrast.

activation_trace.role: Place, position, or rank turns the focus negation into exclusion from a lived social location.
Prescribed worship identifies the first cohort from which the speakers locate themselves outside.
Repeated temporal being extends the same durable negative frame into the next admission.
Feeding another supplies the parallel positive practice that was also absent.
Entering talk or an affair supplies the collective activity in which they did affirmatively participate.
Attributing falsehood supplies their positive stance toward the coming account.
Accounting and recompense identify what their denial rejected.

structural_cues: 74:43-44 repeat ولم نك with absent practices; 74:45-46 switch to وكنا with adopted practices.
The paired practitioner noun in 74:43 and repeated agent noun in 74:45 make group alignment overt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact grammatical repetition and contrasted activities; I infer that the clauses map durable allegiance rather than four isolated deeds. A live alternative is that the answer is simply an additive list of independent liabilities.

changed_reading.after: They had located themselves outside the worship-and-care cohort and inside a rival collective practice of discursive immersion and denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Supplication, blessing, and mercy in the focus prayer branch align with feeding the socially reduced person; later intercession is literally an advocate joining another, yet that joining yields no benefit. Prayer becomes one node in a reciprocal mercy network whose spiritual, material, and advocatory links were all refused or unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Supplication, praise, and mercy supply the focus-side relational current.
Giving food to another materializes mercy as sustaining transfer.
Humbling poverty identifies the vulnerable recipient at the material end of that transfer.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the failed outcome of later advocacy.
An advocate joining another supplies the final interpersonal link that cannot now help them.

structural_cues: 74:43-44 coordinates non-prayer and non-feeding as consecutive answers.
74:48 closes the confession sequence with the failure of joined advocacy to benefit them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent negative acts and later joiner-benefit relation; I infer a common circulation of mercy linking them. A live alternative is that prayer, feeding, and intercession remain separate legal or eschatological categories.

changed_reading.before: Prayer was an isolated God-facing obligation they omitted.
changed_reading.after: They never joined the circulation of mercy that moves through supplication, material feeding, and advocacy, so no such joining benefits them now.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier speech is manufactured through calculation and issued as false attribution and doctrine; the later speakers admit denying the accounting until fixed certainty arrives. قالوا at the focus therefore functions as terminal evidentiary disclosure, reversing the surah's earlier manipulation of speech.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the focus as an audible answer.
Speech as doctrine lets the answer reveal the orientation behind the admitted practice.
Planning by measured consideration supplies the constructed prehistory of the earlier pronouncement.
False saying or attribution marks the earlier public claim as manipulated speech.
A held doctrine gives the earlier label the force of an adopted interpretive stance.
Contradiction of truth supplies the admitted stance that the focus answer exposes.
Fixed knowledge with doubt removed supplies the terminal condition under which denial becomes confession.

structural_cues: 74:18-25 moves from inward calculation to a public القول about the message.
74:43-47 moves from spoken admissions through prior denial to the arrival of certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two staged speech sequences; I infer that the later answer rhetorically reverses the earlier manufacture of a claim. The speakers need not be the same individuals, so the live alternative is a typological contrast across distinct agents rather than one biography.

changed_reading.before: قالوا neutrally reports what they answered.
changed_reading.after: قالوا marks compelled self-evidence: manufactured doctrine and denial collapse into an audible account of the life they actually chose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The race branch of المصلي names the follower immediately behind a leader. The surrounding sequence offers advance or delay, distinguishes companions, asks what route penetrated into Saqar, and contrasts that ordered following with entering talk alongside the waders. The confession can therefore carry a spatial allegiance: they never took position in the close-following line.

activation_trace.role: The second racer following at the leader's flank supplies the focus image of close ordered following.
Advancing forward supplies one available direction of movement.
Delaying supplies the opposed loss of forward position.
Companionship and sustained association supply a named alternative cohort.
Penetrating along a path supplies the route by which the speakers reached Saqar.
Entering talk or an affair with others supplies the rival collective current they did follow.

structural_cues: 74:37-45 proceeds from advance or delay through cohort labels and route-entry to movement with a repeated agent group.
The focus says من المصلين, a placement among practitioners, rather than naming prayer as an abstract object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a race branch and a concentrated movement sequence; I infer a processional allegiance in which disciplined close-following contrasts with collective wading. The live alternative is that the race branch is only a lexical side-branch and contributes no contextual sense to ritual المصلين.

changed_reading.before: They did not belong to the ritual-prayer category.
changed_reading.after: They never took the close follower's position in the advancing cohort; instead they entered the current of the waders and followed it into Saqar.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing recurrence of reminder and remembrance leads to God as the proper object of protective regard and the possessor of forgiveness. Read through prayer's supplication-and-mercy branch, nonmembership among المصلين becomes refusal to keep the reminder active and seek the protective covering it opens.

activation_trace.role: Supplication and mercy anchor prayer as an active relation rather than a bare label.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the summons to which prayer can answer.
Fitness and worthiness identify the proper destination of protective regard and forgiveness-seeking.
Putting oneself under protection supplies the practical orientation of taqwa.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer supplies the mercy sought at the relation's far end.

structural_cues: 74:49-56 repeatedly returns to تذكرة and ذكر after the confession and its consequence.
The surah closes by pairing divine worthiness for protective regard with worthiness for forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reminder refrain and protection-forgiveness ending; I infer that supplicatory prayer is one enacted mode of remaining inside that response. A live alternative is that the closing sequence concerns receptivity to revelation generally, without specifically sharpening المصلين.

changed_reading.before: They failed to carry out prayer as an obligation.
changed_reading.after: They failed to inhabit the repeated remembrance by which a person turns toward protection and forgiving cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because fire-straightening is a form-distant branch, not the direct contextual gloss of المصلين. It remains anchored through the focus root's explicit mapped branch, the same mapped branch at 74:26, and the metal-testing/fire pair at 74:31. Downstream prose should present it only as a controlled lexical-material echo, never as a translation or an equation of prayer with punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المصلين through mapped root_000880 B004, the branch of kindling and straightening an object by controlled fire.

activation_trace.role: Fire used to straighten an object supplies a materially formative image latent at the focus noun.
Kindling and fire-straightening reactivate that material image inside the explicit Saqar threat.
Testing metal or a person supplies the diagnostic action of measured heat.
Burning fire supplies the destructive edge against which formative heat is distinguished.

changed_reading.before: They did not join the worshippers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they refused a formative practice figured as measured straightening, and therefore met heat only in its coercive and destructive mode.

strongest_changes: The 74:43-46 grammar changes a missed prayer into durable cohort alignment: absent from worship and care, present in wading and denial.
The mapped ṣ-l-w/ṣ-l-y inventory and 74:26 create a live voluntary-prayer versus compulsory-fire reversal.
The prayer branch of supplication and mercy joins the adjacent failure to feed with the later failure of intercession to benefit.
The surah's two staged speech sequences turn قالوا from neutral dialogue into terminal self-evidence after manufactured claims and denial.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made recurrence do more than supply themes: repeated being-clauses mapped social location, the prayer/fire root split produced a reversal, and movement, speech, mercy, and remembrance each generated a distinct focus-anchored mechanism without requiring one final harmonized reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The fire and close-follower activations are packet-backed but may remain rhetorical echoes rather than active senses of المصلين.
The opening imperatives may sharpen prayer as formative discipline, or may describe prophetic commission too broadly to define the focus cohort.
The speech reversal may compare distinct rhetorical types rather than track the same agents across the surah.
